claims: effectiveTaxFreeThreshold: TAX_FREE_THRESHOLD + Math.round(700 / SECOND_BRACKET_RATE)  // comment: at 15% it is $22,867
whys: Cross-file fix proposed (and checked by a verifier) in the first fact-fix round. Proposal: Checked the math. Math.round(700/0.15) = 4,667 gives 22,867, and tax at 22,867 is $700.05, which LITO does not fully cancel. Math.floor gives 22,866 at 15% and exactly 22,575 at 16%. The proposed change is Math.round to Math.floor, with the comment changed to $22,866 and any test that pins 22,867 updated. It is sound, but it belongs to the owner of australian-tax.ts. tax-free-threshold.ts:92-97 says that constant is 'rounded ... how it is usually quoted', so the owner should decide. Nothing was edited.
